text.yo: Pariwo "Iná!" kí o sì ké ìkìlọ̀.

text.en: Leave at once. Do not collect your things.
text.yo: Jáde lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀. Má ṣe kó ẹrù rẹ.
text.pcm: Comot sharp sharp. No carry your load.

text.en: Stay low if there is smoke. Use the stairs, not the lift.
text.yo: Wólẹ̀ tí èéfín bá wà. Lo àtẹ̀gùn, má lo lifiti.
text.pcm: Bend low if smoke dey. Use stairs, no use lift.

text.en: Go to open ground away from the building. Call 112. Never go back inside.
text.yo: Lọ sí ibi gbangba tó jìnnà sí ilé. Pe 112. Má padà sínú ilé.
text.pcm: Go open place wey far from house. Call 112. No go back inside.

text.en: Make sure the place is safe for you.
text.yo: Rí i dájú pé ibẹ̀ kò séwu fún ọ.
text.pcm: Make sure say the place safe for you.

text.en: Call for help right away: 112 or the Health Centre.
text.yo: Pe ìrànwọ́ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀: 112 tàbí Ilé ìtọ́jú ìlera.
text.pcm: Call help sharp sharp: 112 or Health Centre.

text.en: Stay with the person. Do not move them if they may have a neck or back injury.
text.yo: Dúró ti ẹni náà. Má ṣe gbé e tí ọrùn tàbí ẹ̀yìn rẹ̀ bá lè ti farapa.
text.pcm: Stay with the person. No move am if e fit get neck or back injury.

text.en: Tell the helpers exactly where you are.
text.yo: Sọ ibi tí ẹ wà fún àwọn olùrànlọ́wọ́ ní pàtó.
text.pcm: Tell helpers exactly where una dey.

text.en: Move to a place with many people and light.
text.yo: Lọ sí ibi tí ọ̀pọ̀ èèyàn àti ìmọ́lẹ̀ wà.
text.pcm: Go where plenty people and light dey.

text.en: Do not argue or fight. Keep your distance.
text.yo: Má jà, má sì bá wọn ṣe àríyànjiyàn. Jìnnà sí wọn.
text.pcm: No quarrel, no fight. Stay far.

text.en: Call or text campus security. Tell someone you trust.
text.yo: Pe tàbí fi ọ̀rọ̀ ránṣẹ́ sí ààbò ogba. Sọ fún ẹni tí o fọkàn tán.
text.pcm: Call or text campus security. Tell person wey you trust.

text.en: Write down what happened as soon as you can.
text.yo: Kọ ohun tó ṣẹlẹ̀ sílẹ̀ ní kété tí o bá lè ṣe é.
text.pcm: Write wetin happen as soon as you fit.

text.en: Your safety comes first. Do not fight for your things.
text.yo: Ààbò rẹ ló ṣe pàtàkì jù. Má jà fún ẹrù rẹ.
text.pcm: Your safety first. No fight for your things.

text.en: Remember how the person looked and where they went.
text.yo: Ṣàkíyèsí bí ẹni náà ṣe rí àti ibi tó lọ.
text.pcm: Remember how the person look and where e go.

text.en: Block your bank cards and SIM if they were taken.
text.yo: Dá káàdì báńkì àti SIM rẹ dúró tí wọ́n bá gbà wọ́n.
text.pcm: Block your bank card and SIM if dem carry am.
